description: This file defines the LoanTermVariationsData class which models variations in loan terms, including properties such as variation type, applicability dates, and flags for installment-specific variations and processing status. It provides methods to determine whether a variation is applicable based on given dates and includes comparison logic among variations.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsData
classes.description: A data class representing variations in loan terms, such as interest rate changes or installment adjustments, with properties for variation type, dates, and methods for applicability and comparison.

methods.name: getTermVariationType
methods.description: Returns the variation type as a LoanTermVariationType enum based on the termType property.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the variation is applicable between a start and end date range.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpTo
methods.description: Helper method to determine if a target date falls within a date range.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the variation is applicable from a specific date onward.

methods.name: occursBefore
methods.description: Helper method to determine if a date occurs before or on a target date.

methods.name: isSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Returns whether the variation is specific to an installment.

methods.name: isProcessed
methods.description: Returns whether the variation has been marked as processed.

methods.name: setProcessed
methods.description: Sets the processed status of the variation.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this variation with another to determine order based on applicability date and variation type.

methods.name: setApplicableFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date from which the variation applies.
